title: EOS Material
description: Condition-neutral Material Knowledge Entity and Aggregate Root. It owns PropertyRecord claims and Classification assignments but does not own Observation, StockMaterial, Supplier or manufacturing compatibility data.

id.description: Stable identity of exactly one Material entity. Name and future designations are not identity.

sourceLinks.description: Root provenance for the Material identity and definition. It does not replace claim, assignment or evidence provenance.

name.description: Canonical human-readable EOS label. It is not identity, designation or structurally unique.

description.description: Optional explanation of the Material concept boundary; it does not replace structured claims or classifications.

properties.description: Parent-owned technical claims. Multiple or conflicting claims for one propertyId are preserved.

classifications.description: Parent-owned classification assignments. The Material does not own Classification Catalog Entries.

replaces.description: Optional structural reference to one older Material replaced by this entity. Target existence is deferred.

replacedBy.description: Optional structural reference to one newer Material replacing this entity. Target existence is deferred.
